question: Which metal is used in electroplating on iron to protect it from corrosion and formation of rust?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zinc.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Zinc is widely used for **galvanization**, a process where a protective layer of zinc is applied to iron or steel to prevent rusting and corrosion.
 
• **Electroplating** is a technique that uses electric current to deposit a thin layer of metal onto a surface.
 
• In electroplating, zinc acts as a **sacrificial anode**, meaning it will corrode preferentially to protect the underlying metal (iron) from corrosion.
 
• Zinc coatings are commonly used in various industries, such as construction and automotive, to enhance the **durability** of steel products exposed to harsh environments.
 
• Zinc is an essential trace element in human nutrition, playing a crucial role in** immune function**, **protein synthesis**, and wound healing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rhodium:**

 
 
• Rhodium is a highly reflective and **corrosion-resistant** metal often used for plating jewelry and high-end automotive parts to enhance appearance and durability.
 
• Rhodium plating is commonly applied over silver or white gold to provide a bright, reflective finish and to prevent tarnishing.
 
 
 
• **Chromium:**
 
 
• Chromium is known for its high hardness and **resistance to corrosion**, making it ideal for plating automotive parts and tools to enhance their lifespan.
 
• Chromium plating provides a shiny finish, commonly used in decorative applications like faucets, bumpers, and household fixtures.
 
 
 
• **Tin:**
 
 
• Tin plating is often used on iron and steel to prevent rust, especially in food packaging to ensure the safety of canned goods.
 
• Tin is commonly used in electronics for **soldering components** due to its excellent conductivity and ability to resist corrosion.
